environment: Arena platform egress (reaches hltv.org, gamma-api.polymarket.com, clob.polymarket.com, api.smarkets.com). The GitHub Actions runner that builds the site records HTTP 403 from hltv.org, so HLTV reads are done here and recorded as dated evidence.
policy: Leads and limitations only. No probability, pick or alias is written by hand; the four-hour pipeline (scripts/originate.py) alone decides whether a line is usable.
HLTV is read first for every fixture, then exchanges/markets.
Hotspawn 'picked_percent' and HLTV 'Pick a winner' fan polls are crowd votes, never probabilities; they are recorded as excluded evidence only.
A map-winner market (Polymarket sportsMarketType 'child_moneyline') is never a series line.
A value that could not be read from an official page is left null and marked unverified.

limitations_of_this_research: HLTV renders match times in the viewer's timezone, so HLTV clock times are not recorded as UTC; UTC starts are taken from Polymarket gameStartTime where shown.
Ranks are recorded only where the page segment read showed them; the rest are null (unverified), not inferred.
Wide-book midpoints are recorded as observations only and are never converted into a published probability by hand.
Bookmakers that render odds client-side or geo-block (e.g. Pinnacle, Bovada, Thunderpick UI) were not re-read this session; the pipeline's own Thunderpick/Pinnacle rungs run every refresh.
